name: Apogee Enterprises
outlook:
What Apogee Enterprises says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: net sales and adjusted diluted EPSThe Company now expects net sales in the range of $1.46 billion to $1.50 billion, compared with its previous range of $1.38 billion to $1.43 billion, and adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $3.00 to $3.40, compared with its previous range of $2.70 to $3.25. The Company’s outlook also assumes interest expense of approximately $15 million, an adjusted effective tax rate of approximately 26%, and capital expenditures between $35 million and $40 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
